set.approach: Hike the 50 Year Trail to the Gem Trail and turn left. Watch for a pumpkin-sized orange boulder beside the trail on the left, then cairns lead over a draw to the boulder. Diagonal Crack is the sunny hand-and-fist crack, with an open project beside it on the left.

review.notes: Approach from the area page; no descent method stated (anchors only), so approach only.

set.approach: From the 50 Year Trail, look for the small spire near the base of the hill. Leave the trail, cross Sutherland Wash, climb a little, duck under a fence and cross a draw to reach its base. The crack is on the shady northwest side of the spire.
set.descent_text: Bolted anchors at the top are used to get down.

review.notes: Route page states bolted anchors to get down; area page gives the approach.
